title: Terminal block control panel
goal: A reader must be able to identify where field wiring enters, how it is fused and selected, and where the switched output leaves.

rubric.must: Two terminal blocks with visibly numbered terminals are shown at the drawing edge.
Field wiring visibly enters the first terminal block and leaves through the second.
A 24 VDC supply passes through a clearly labelled 1 A fuse.
A labelled HAND-OFF-AUTO selector switch is visible upstream of the relay coil.
A 24 VDC control relay and a green RUN pilot light are both visible.
Reference designators and ratings remain legible without overlapping symbols.

ideal.notes: Reviewed. Both terminal blocks sit at the drawing's edges with their terminals in numbered order, field wiring arriving from outside and internal wiring from inside — the convention the engine currently ignores.
